objective_and_flow.role_in_flow: Source of truth do catálogo HiBit (produtos, categorias, estoque) — publica eventos de mudança de catálogo; consumido via REST pelo hb-catalog-web (admin) e, a partir da Fase 3, pelo sc-order-service (totem)
objective_and_flow.trigger: Requisições REST autenticadas (Keycloak realm hibit) do hb-catalog-web; a partir da Fase 3, reservas de estoque do sc-order-service
objective_and_flow.action: CRUD de produtos/categorias, gestão de estoque (movements IN/OUT + reservations reserve/release/commit com Idempotency-Key) e publicação de eventos via Transactional Outbox na exchange catalog.events

events.name: ProductCreated
events.destination: exchange catalog.events (routing key catalog.product.created); consumidor previsto: sc-order-service (Fase 3, invalidação de cache do totem)

events.name: ProductUpdated
events.destination: exchange catalog.events (routing key catalog.product.updated); consumidor previsto: sc-order-service (Fase 3)

events.name: ProductDeactivated
events.destination: exchange catalog.events (routing key catalog.product.deactivated); consumidor previsto: sc-order-service (Fase 3)

events.name: StockChanged
events.destination: exchange catalog.events (routing key catalog.stock.changed); consumidor previsto: sc-order-service (Fase 3)

events.name: PriceChanged
events.destination: exchange catalog.events (routing key catalog.price.changed); consumidor previsto: sc-order-service (Fase 3)

response_patterns: RFC 7807 ProblemDetail para todos os erros (ApiExceptionHandler)
Idempotency-Key header obrigatório nas 4 mutações de estoque (movements, reserve, release, commit) — IdempotencyFilter + tabela idempotency_key durável
201 Created com header Location em POST de criação (products, categories)
Paginação: {content, page, size, totalElements, totalPages} (ProductPageResponse, StockMovementPageResponse)
contract_compliance.shared_contracts_location: platform-shared-contracts/ (contracts-catalog/openapi/catalog.yaml; build-only via mvn -B install, publicação remota adiada — ADR 0006)

local_stack.persistence: PostgreSQL 16 + Flyway (ddl-auto: validate; migrações V1__init, V2__price_history, V3__stock_idempotency, V4__create_outbox_messages)
local_stack.security: OAuth2 Resource Server — Keycloak realm hibit; KeycloakRealmRoleConverter (realm_access.roles); @PreAuthorize("hasRole('admin')") nas mutações
others: UUID v7 PK gerado no banco via uuidv7() (ADR 0009)

simulation_instructions: Criar produto: curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '<ProductRequest>'

Registrar movimento de estoque: curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/products/{productId}/stock/movements -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Idempotency-Key: <uuid>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '<StockMovementRequest>'
Verificar evento na exchange catalog.events via http://localhost:15672
Explorar contratos via Swagger UI: http://localhost:8080/swagger-ui.html
